text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps you track progress and stay motivated. Deliverables are the concrete results you promise to produce, such as reports or products. It is also important to align goals with stakeholders, including team members, clients, and managers, so everyone shares the same expectations. When goals are well defined and agreed upon, projects are more likely to finish on time and within budget.
